The '''''Hardcell''-class interstellar transport''', also known as the '''''Hardcell''-class transport''', the '''Hardcell transport''', '''Techno Union transport''', or '''Techno Union starship''', was a model of [[transport]] manufactured by the [[Techno Union]] and utilized by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[First Battle of Geonosis]], the opening battle of the [[Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:HardcellClassTransport-SWM35.png|thumb|300px|left|''Hardcell-''class transports were better equipped for personnel and vehicle transport than battle.]]
The ''Hardcell''-class interstellar [[transport]], also known as the [[Techno Union]] transport,<ref name="BMF 57" /> the Hardcell transport,<ref name="On the Front Lines">''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]''</ref> or the Techno Union starship,<ref name="Wat Tambor" /> was a 220 [[meter]] long [[starship]] that was equipped with a class 1 [[hyperdrive]], could travel at speeds of 4,000 [[Kilometer per hour|kilometers per hour]], and was equipped with two [[laser cannon]] batteries. It had six retro [[rocket booster]]s and a [[titanium]] [[hull]].<ref name="BMF 57" />

The [[fuel cell]]s were located on the mid-section of the vessel above the rockets, and were a weak point for the ship. Due to its lack of [[repulsorlift]]s, it had limited maneuverability in [[planet]]ary [[atmosphere]]. They could transport over 100 [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank|IG-227 ''Hailfire''-class droid tanks]] and 1,017 passengers, over 100 of which were [[IG lancer droid]]s.<ref name="BMF 57" /> Due to its conventional method of propulsion and limited armament, as warships the ''Hardcell''-class were ineffective against the [[Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Starfighters" />

==Role==
During the [[First Battle of Geonosis]], ''Hardcell''-class interstellar transports were first used as military vehicles to transport IG-227 ''Hailfire''-class [[droid tank]]s.<ref name="Starfighters" /> A combat refit known as the [[Hardcell-class Battle Refit|''Hardcell''-class Battle Refit]] was designed for fighting.<ref name="Combat Transport">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2020/12/1/combat-transport|text=Combat Transport}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:SWM35-SAFS-boxart.png|thumb|300px|left|A pair of ''Hardcell''-class transports flying escort with a ''Munificent''-class star frigate.]]
''Hardcell''-class interstellar transports were commonly seen before the start of the [[Clone Wars]]. At the Battle of [[Geonosis]], 286 ''Hardcell''-class interstellar transports deployed 4,100 IG-227 [[droid]] [[tank]]s against the [[Grand Army of the Republic]],<ref name="Starfighters" /> although 117 were ultimately destroyed.<ref name="CL2016">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> The ''[[Foreman's Labor]]'' was among the Hardcell transports that fought in [[Realspace|space]] over Geonosis.<ref name="Foreman">{{Armada|set=Separatist Alliance Fleet Starter|cardname=''Foreman's Labor''}}</ref> The Hardcell saw continued use during the Clone Wars, with the ''[[Beast of Burden]]'' flying as part of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy|CIS fleet]] at one point.<ref name="Beast of Burden">{{Armada|set=Separatist Alliance Fleet Starter|cardname=''Beast of Burden''}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The digital effects data for the ''Hardcell''-class transport stated it is 640 [[Foot|feet]] tall.<ref name="ImageAttack">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2003/06/imageattack20030611.html|series=Image Attack|text=Hardcell-Class}}</ref>
